name: gizza-ai/raw-rgb-to-png
summary: Assemble raw RGB/RGBA bytes plus width and height into a PNG

tool.description: Assemble raw pixel bytes into a viewable PNG image. Provide data as hex byte pairs, base64, or decimal byte values; provide width and height; choose pixel_format rgb (3 bytes per pixel) or rgba (4 bytes per pixel); optionally set row_stride when rows are padded. The tool validates dimensions, byte counts, stride, and malformed input, then returns an image/png media envelope named raw-rgb.png. It is for headerless framebuffer dumps, texture bytes, embedded raw pixel arrays, and debugging output from image pipelines; it does not decode file formats or infer dimensions.

data.description: Raw pixel bytes as text. encoding=hex accepts hex byte pairs like ff0000 or 0xff,0x00,0x00; encoding=base64 accepts standard or URL-safe base64 and data:...;base64,... prefixes; encoding=decimal accepts 0-255 byte values separated by commas/spaces. Required.

encoding.description: How the data string is encoded: hex byte pairs (default), base64 bytes, or decimal byte values 0-255.

height.description: Image height in pixels, 1-8192. Required. width × height must be at most 16,000,000 pixels.

pixel_format.description: How to read each pixel: rgb = 3 bytes per pixel (red, green, blue); rgba = 4 bytes per pixel (red, green, blue, alpha). Default rgb.

row_stride.description: Bytes from the start of one row to the start of the next when rows are padded. 0 means tightly packed width × bytes-per-pixel. Must be at least one row of pixels when set. Default 0.
